question: What comparable merit arises from giving thousands of horse sacrifices in another world?
premises: Thousands of horse sacrifices constitute a great ritual gift.
Such gifts were given by a ruler of another world.
The comparison establishes a benchmark of ritual merit.
inference: The giving of thousands of horse sacrifices by another-world ruler serves as a standard of immense merit.
uncertainties: The identity of anya+bhuvanaḥ is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: Likewise, a ruler of another world gave thousands of horse sacrifices.
